mira_pm: Heads-up: we need a concise pilot rubric for the Optimize toolkit (batching, caching, quant recs + eval-triggered alerts) to share with 3 pilot customers next week. Can we land on concrete pass/fail criteria?

tom_engineer: Thinking shortest path: 3 gates — cost, latency, and quality stability. For cost let's target >=6% net token cost reduction vs baseline over the canary window.

ana_research: For quality stability I'd map to per-customer eval sets. Proposed threshold: absolute change <= 0.025 on the primary metric (e.g., accuracy/concordance); if no single metric, use a small suite and require no more than 1 failing metric.

chris_sre: Operational requirements: 1) canary traffic cap 4% for 24h, 2) health check for KV cache hits (if caching enabled), 3) auto-fallback to original precision model on any error or >15% latency spike.

mira_pm: Love those numbers. For latency gate, we should require p95 steady-state within target and p95 improvement >=10% when enabling batching. p99 can be exempt during warm-up but measure steady-state after 3 minutes.

recommendation-bot: FYI: suggested alert config -> ``alert_eval_regressions: window: 7d max_regressions: 4 quality_delta_threshold: 0.025``

tom_engineer: Add an acceptance test: run a synthetic workload + representative customer sample for 24h. Success = all gates green: cost <= -6% (i.e., at least 6% savings), latency pass, and eval regressions <= threshold. Any failing gate -> immediate rollback and postmortem.

ana_research: For pilot materials include guidance on interpreting eval alerts (false positives expected). Recommend initial tuning: start with max_regressions=4 then tighten after 2 weeks if noise low. Provide examples: A model with a small degradation on rarer intents might trigger an alert but still be acceptable if top-level metrics unchanged.

chris_sre: Runbook notes: ensure the rollout has these hooks: deploy flag to disable recs per-tenant, a metric stream showing per-tenant cost delta and eval delta, and an automated canary monitor that can pause traffic if error rate or latency crosses thresholds. Also require a manual "hold" button in the console for legal/compliance requests.

mira_pm: For customer-facing one-pager: include opt-out steps, how to pin models, expected visibility (Slack + email); brief section on quant tradeoffs and how to request a manual review. Keep wording non-technical.

tom_engineer: I'll draft the internal checklist and a tiny decision table: GREEN if all gates pass; YELLOW if cost+latency pass but quality borderline (<=6 regressions/14d) -> extend canary to 72h; RED otherwise -> rollback and block reattempt until fixes.

recommendation-bot: Deploy reminder: optimize-toolkit/canary scheduled 2026-03-29T03:00:00Z at 4% traffic.

mira_pm: Great. Can somebody create the internal doc and a short customer summary? I'll review the checklist after PR. :thumbsup:

chris_sre: I'll add the monitoring panels and automatic rollback hooks to the runbook and link to the doc once done.

tom_engineer: PR incoming with checklist + example alert YAML by EOD.

mira_pm: Thanks team — aiming to have pilot-ready artifacts by Friday.
